title: Home camera guard for Windows
lead: Person detection on your own computer with alerts and recordings, and no cloud.
problem: People want a guard that runs at home, does not send video to the internet and does not wake them for nothing: shadows, cats and headlights.
built: Capture from an ordinary camera; a recording keeps about 10 seconds before a person appears and up to a minute after they leave; recordings are kept for 14 days.
Person detection on your computer: the model is a plain file on disk and runs offline; with a graphics card a more accurate model can be switched on.
A judge against false alarms with five rules: a person in at least 3 of 5 frames in a row; uncertain detections dropped; tiny boxes ignored
Messages: someone is home, is it you? (30 seconds to answer), then an alarm with a recording; an all-is-well message on a schedule; camera offline within a minute.
Arming and disarming with a PIN.

steps: The camera watches a door or balcony.
The program on your laptop decides whether a person is in the frame.
The judge filters out shadows, light changes and still objects.
If it is a person, you get a message and the video is saved locally.
offer: Setup on your laptop with a camera: camera check, sensitivity, a test night run.
A control window and Telegram messages, built separately for you.
Condition: the laptop must stay awake and plugged in.
price_en: Starting at pilot $180 for a pilot
